title: Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret
abstract: arXiv:2611.19575v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at

translated_title: 风险规避的决策聚焦学习：最小化遗憾的条件风险价值（CVaR）
translated_abstract: 许多组合优化（CO）问题在必须求解时其参数是不确定的。在这种情形下，需要先从相关的上下文信息中预测这些参数，然后才能计算求解方案。决策聚焦学习（DFL）通过训练预测模型来产生能够优化下游决策质量的预测，从而解决这一问题。现有的大多数DFL方法是风险中性的，即最小化期望遗憾。在高风险应用中，这可能导致不良结果，因为决策者还必须考虑决策质量的尾部风险。先前的风险敏感方法通常显式地对不确定性建模，并在推理时求解随机优化或鲁棒优化问题，这增加了计算复杂性。与之不同，我们提出了一个DFL框架，它在保持点预测和推理时确定性优化的同时，实现了风险敏感的行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种风险规避的决策聚焦学习框架，通过最小化遗憾的条件风险价值（CVaR）而非期望遗憾来考虑决策质量的尾部风险，同时保持点预测和确定性优化，无需在推理阶段引入额外的计算复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a risk-averse decision-focused learning framework that minimizes the CVaR of regret instead of expected regret, thereby accounting for the tail risk of decision quality while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization without added inference-time computational complexity.
